_doc: The card game at No Law's card table in saloon B's bar room (#1230; was the yard's; #766, No Law step 2; CardGame, src/people/card_game.gd): five-card draw among whoever is sat at it (two or more), the player dealt in when he sits in a free chair there. A scene, not a minigame (Sean, #766): the men deal, ante, bet, draw and show by these rules and numbers, saying a line now and then; on your turn a nod calls (or checks) and a shake folds, and if you do neither for `you_wait_s` you check, or fold to a bet. It runs until something stops it (`stop_on`, a man out of his chair, an act's `interrupt`); the cards stay where they lie. Chips are a stake each, no money yet.
status: PROPOSED (#766): the game, the stakes, the timings and the lines are this session's; No Law (docs/missions/no-law.md) asks only for 'a card game' that's interrupted.

beats._doc: Seconds: the shuffle, everyone's ante, a card dealt every deal_every_s (each in the air card_fly_s), a man's think (between the two), the draw a man, the showdown's look, between hands; on your turn you're waited on you_wait_s; a chip pushed takes chip_fly_s.

play._doc: How the men play their cards (Poker.strength, 0..1: a pair of jacks ~0.47): open the betting past open_at, raise past raise_at (each with its chance), call with anything past call_at, and with less now and then (bluff_call); a man folds what he won't call.

cheat._doc: Earl deals himself from the bottom now and then (No Law: the card player Cody believes has been cheating): dealing, `odds` that one of his cards is swapped for one that pairs his best. Counted in the report (`cheated`).

_same_line: #1184: no line the table said within this (s); the lines came round every few hands.

stop_on._doc: A shot this near (m), a blast this near: the hand's over.

place._doc: Where things lie on the table, from its middle toward each chair (m): a man's cards `cards_in` from the middle, spread `card_gap` apart; his chips `chips_in`, `chips_side` to his right; the pot `pot_off` from the middle; the deck by the dealer `deck_in`.

you.turn: Your bet: {call} to call. Nod: call · shake: fold · fire: raise
you.turn_check: Your bet. Nod: check · shake: fold · fire: raise
you.next_hand: You're in from the next hand
you.hurry: Nod to call, shake to fold: 3 s left.

_needle_pot: #1279: a pot this big or more taken by you, and the next hand starts with a man needling you (lines `needle`).
_accuse_gap_s: #1279: a cheat called (a shout sat at the table, CardGame.accuse) at most once in this long (s).

invite._doc: #1279: you stood within `m` of the table's middle for `after_s`, a chair free and a game on: a man asks you to sit (lines `invite`), once each `gap_s`.

lines._doc: What the men say (Events.spoke: his mouth and the subtitle), one picked at random, at most one a man every say_gap_s and each only say_chance of the time (a win always). {hand} the hand's name, {n} cards. `by` a man's own lines over these. No line the table said within the game's `same_line_s` (#1184); all said lately, he keeps quiet, a win too (#1213). `greet` when you sit down, `you_broke` when you're cleaned out.
shuffle: Let's see if these are any kinder.
Ante up. You know the price.
bet: Bet two bits more'n it's worth.
raise: Let's make it worth the lamp oil.
draw_1: One card. That's all I ask.
draw_2: Two, if you'd be so good.
win: {hand}. Don't all thank me at once.
win_quiet: Nobody wants it? I'll mind it for you.
Scared off, the lot of you.
lose: That's a lot of hand for this table.
you_win: Well, look at the new fella.
Don't get used to it, mister.
greet: Pull up a chair. Your money's as good as anybody's.
you_broke: That's the lot of it, mister.
Cleaned out. Happens to the best of us. Happened to you.
lines._doc_you: #1279, every verb gets an answer (DESIGN §2 pillar 6), said at once: `you_raise` the next man to act at your raise ({n} the bet); `you_call` at your call, `you_check` now and then at your check; `you_win_quiet` your pot taken with nobody left in (they never saw your cards); `you_lose` the man who beat you ({hand} his); `bluff_called` the same when you'd raised on nothing and it was shown down; `accused` the man you call a cheat when he isn't one (or wasn't this hand), `accused_seen` another man at it; `caught` the cheat caught dealing from the bottom, `cheat_seen` another man at it; `you_up` / `you_up_ahead` as you get up (ahead: more than you sat down with); `invite` a man asking you to sit; `needle` the hand after you took a big pot.
you_raise: Big bet for a quiet man.
you_win_quiet: Take it, then. Didn't want to see 'em anyhow.
Keep your secrets, mister. Keep the pot too.
bluff_called: Thought so. Nothing in that hand but nerve.
Raised on that? Mister, you got sand. No cards, but sand.
Ha! I knew it. Bluffing on a busted hand.
accused: You calling me a cheat, mister?
Them's hard words for a man who can't play.
accused_seen: Easy, now. It's a clean game.
Watch your mouth. He's lost same as you.
Mister, you'd best take that back.
caught: Now hold on, hold on. It slipped, is all.
You never saw a thing. Nobody saw a thing.
cheat_seen: From the bottom. I saw it too.
I knew it. Every damn hand, I knew it.
you_up_ahead: Walking off with our money, then.
Quit while you're ahead. Smart. Ugly, but smart.
invite: You going to stand there all night? Chair's free.
Watching won't win you anything, mister. Sit.
Sit down or move along, mister.
needle: Let's see you do that twice.
That's our money in front of you, mister. We'll want it back.

accused: Cheat? Me? I've played this table twenty years.
You calling me a cheat? In front of God and the drifter?
caught: Now hold on. The card slipped, is all. It slipped.
I never. That's a damn lie. ...It slipped.
win: {hand}. Don't look at me like that.
{hand}. Clean deck, boys. Clean as Sunday.
{hand}. Read 'em out loud, boys, if you can.
shuffle: These cards have been against me since Christmas.
Deal's mine. Watch my hands, if you like.

lose: You're a lucky old man, Earl.
